title: Tacticool Equipment
description: A couple of 3D modeled weapons in a modern/near future/cyberpunk style. Custom movesets with Better Combat!
body:
![Minecraft hatsune miku holding a pair of combat knives.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/663b1c8a335db3cfe432fdc7519dfe0994d3164f.png)
Do you too feel that minecraft's existing weapons are lacking for a modern/scifi experience? Do you too dislike using the same old diamond sword when you're fighting off cyborg monstrosities? Do you too feel the increasingly irrepressible urge to bash zombies over the head with a shovel? Well golly gee do I have the mod for you.

Presenting: Tacticool Equipment! A mod that add a handful of weapons and tools that double as weapons. In addition to having nice 3D models, they also all have custom movesets when paired with Better Combat.

![a picture of a minecraft combat knife facing upwards](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/84d245ab9a1e86d3a288a6290a71d0ad00f9b675.png)

Note that while you could absolutely just use them on their own, they're not going to be very unique without the fancy movesets Better Combat provides. Also, the general balancing is meant for fighting more powerful mobs, such as an infection mod, paired alongside some kind of gun mod. I usually like to use [TACZ](https://modrinth.com/mod/timeless-and-classics-zero) paired with the [MS-MOBIUS Gunpack](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/customization/tacz-ms-mobius-gunpack) (Not available on Modrinth).

Enjoy!
